why_ai: Screen-based software, protected by tax-jurisdiction content, money-movement plumbing and filing liability.
why_clarity: Correct net pay and filings are exact, on a fixed recurring calendar.
why_digital: Time and tax data in, payments and filings out, all electronic.

why_ai: Detecting returned deposits and validating accounts is automatic payments monitoring.
why_clarity: A payment either lands or is returned, known almost instantly.
why_digital: Bank return data in, corrected payments out.

why_ai: Extracting court orders and applying published priority rules is an AI document task.
why_clarity: Priority, disposable income and exemption rules are published and exact.
why_digital: Paper court orders in, payroll deductions out.

why_ai: Fixed household employer obligations suit fully automated, AI-guided self-service.
why_clarity: Household employment taxes and filings are fixed, well-defined obligations.
why_digital: Online self-service payroll for families, though much household pay is cash.

why_ai: The highest-frequency wage panel in the country is proprietary data no AI can recreate.
why_clarity: What credible payroll indices should measure is still unsettled.
why_digital: Structured payroll records in, data products out.

why_ai: Practitioners are accountable for runs, but checking and reconciling are mechanical work.
why_clarity: Each run must reconcile exactly against a fixed calendar.
why_digital: Payroll system data verified and reconciled on screens.

why_ai: Filing liability across 11,000 jurisdictions makes tax content the protected moat.
why_clarity: Correct rates are exact, but errors often surface only when a notice arrives.
why_digital: Rule research and filings are entirely electronic.

why_ai: Checking pay configurations against published wage law is rules work AI handles.
why_clarity: Published rules make configurations checkable, though errors surface later in claims.
why_digital: Earnings rules and time data processed entirely in software.

why_ai: Predictable pre-run exceptions are ideal for automated detection.
why_clarity: Exceptions either break the run or not, known by the deadline.
why_digital: Timecard data in, validated payroll inputs out.

why_ai: Turning hours into gross pay is mechanical calculation software performs.
why_clarity: Gross pay from hours and rules is an exact, repeated computation.
why_digital: Time data in, gross pay out, all in software.

why_ai: Explaining a pay statement from the existing calculation is a direct LLM task.
why_clarity: Every statement is similar, but what reads as legible is subjective.
why_digital: Pay data in, an app or statement out.
